sourceInspected: Existing devotee name input is single element #name at line 11218
Existing nakshatram input is single free-text input #star with placeholder 'അശ്വതി, ഭരണി... (Optional)' at line 11222; NO dropdown or predefined star select exists in Temple_Accounts-1.html

Catalogue contains exactly 13 predefined Vazhipadu items and 1 Punarudharanam item in BILLING_DEFAULT_ITEMS (lines 8029-8044), plus dynamically appended Custom Vazhipadu option (appendCustomVazhipaduOption, line 8116)
Billing quantity control is #qty input with stepper billingAdjustQty() (min 1, max 500, integer) at lines 11229-11236

Pricing calculation in updatePrice() supports fixed-rate (calculatedTotal = price * qty), Custom Vazhipadu (calculatedTotal = Math.round(rate * qty * 100) / 100), and variable donation (user entered total)
Form validation in billingSubmitForm() requires category, item, custom rate/name if custom, devotee name, integer quantity >= 1, total > 0, payment mode
Bill and receipt creation occurs atomically in fsCreateBillingWithAccounting() inside a single Firestore transaction allocating one sequential global counter and reservation doc
Cash Book and Bank Book read strictly from receipts collection; billing collection is operational POS and thermal reprint store, ensuring zero double counting
Payment modes in billing are strictly single-mode 'Cash' or 'UPI'; no split/mixed payment mode exists in the application

Thermal printing hardcoded to 58mm in 9 distinct code and style locations including @media print (#print-area.billing-58mm), inline @page injection (size: 58mm auto), receipt-paper-box (max-width: 300px), and status announcer strings
Reprinting via reprintBillingRecord() directly calls renderThermalReceiptHTML() and printBillingReceipt(), reusing persisted billing document data
Full backup and restore in downloadBackup() / restoreBackup() serializes and restores entire collections as JSON, tolerating new structured fields without schema violation
testEvidenced: Atomic synchronization between billing and receipts validated in test_step_33_22_idempotency_application_hardening.js
Monotonic unified sequence numbering (BILL-xxx / R-xxx) verified in test_step_33_12_unified_numbering_suite.js
Dynamic button states and double-submission protection verified in test_step_33_23_dynamic_button_suite.js
Printer paper feed animation and 50 FPS performance verified in test_step_33_25_printer_animation.js and STEP_33_30C_THERMAL_50FPS_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md
Custom Vazhipadu integration, rate validation, and CSV export verified in test_step_33_56b_custom_vazhipadu.js
unresolved: Physical printer output on actual 80 mm hardware requires live testing with physical ESC/POS or browser driver on target device
Quantity auto-synchronization policy for batch/family pujas (e.g. Ganapathi Homam with multiple family names) vs per-person offerings (Archana) requires operator preference confirmation
Nakshatram selection UX: whether to provide a standard 27-star datalist/dropdown or maintain free-text input with datalist autocomplete requires administrative alignment
